newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's LUKoil seeks preferred share issue-agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia's LUKoil seeks preferred share issue-agency.

text.p: The board of directors of Russia's largest oil producer NK LUKoil will request that shareholders authorise up to 10 million new preferred shares at its June 5 annual meeting, Prime-Tass news agency quoted a source in the company as saying on Tuesday.
Prime said LUKoil LKOH_p.RTS planned to use the preferred shares, to be issued at the discretion of the board, as a deposit for its participation in a number of newly organised oil and gas companies.

OAO Neftyanaya Kompaniya LUKoil securities director Leonid Fedun said in February that the firm planned to issue new preferred shares to help pay for acquisitions, but did not forsee such an issue this year.
Trade in LUKoil preferred American Depositary Receipts began in February.
Prime said LUKoil had 77.2 million preferred shares that made up 10.34 percent of the company's charter capital.
The new shares with a 25 rouble nominal value, could bring the preferred shares of the charter capital to 11.52 percent.
LUKoil preferreds closed on the Russian Trading System at $10.68 on Tuesday, down from $10.85 on Monday.
